description:
Grab your closest ally and set out on an adventure to dominate the deep reaches of Azeroth! In this single-life Hardcore challenge, you and one friend will partner up to tackle all vanilla dungeons in order. Succeed, and you'll earn your place as one of Azeroth's most dynamic duos. Fail, and your character will fall in the depths like so many before.
